best_idea: Freeze the outgoing pose at the frame it is on and blend it to the live pose over a short fixed time, and scrub a single 0-to-1 value (steer, or a stance lean) between a centre frame and two side frames.
decision_why: The frozen-pose hand-off suits a hero landing back into a stance or leaving a hit-react without a pop, and the one-value scrub suits a client-only lean or stance depth; Frankendom keeps both on the client, takes the transition length and blend-on list from the catalogue, and clamps the scrub input in the engine.
acceptance: A player sees a hero landing from a jump settle into the stance over the catalogue blend time with no pop, and a stance lean scrubs smoothly between centre, left and right frames; a unit test on src/fight/hero-pose.ts asserts that the blend equals the frozen sample at start and the live sample once the blend passes 1, and that a scrub input of 2 is clamped to 1 before the frame is picked.
